title: Life Plan Member Bulletin: Absence Credits for Entrance Fee Agreement Holders in Assisted Living
content:
**For Life Plan households with an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

A customer who holds an Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status pays a care fee lowered by the plan's vested care discount, so the absence-relief credit returns only what was paid:

- an Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status whose **occupancy date is at least 60 whole months before the handling date** reduces the credit by the plan's **full care fee discount percentage**;
- an occupied agreement of **shorter standing** reduces the credit by **0.5 of that percentage** (one half of it);
- a customer **without** an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement receives the credit without this reduction.

The reduction is taken from the credit itself, before the credit is rounded once to the cent. The care fee discount percentage is the one set for the agreement's plan in the Entrance Fee Agreement terms. Whole months are counted from the occupancy date to the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the occupancy date.

### Illustration (hypothetical plan with a care fee discount of 10 percent; credit before rounding 906.7741…)

| Entrance Fee Agreement | Reduction | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Occupied, occupancy date 61 whole months before the handling date | 10 percent | 906.7741… multiplied by 0.90: 816.10 |
| Occupied, occupancy date exactly 60 whole months before | 10 percent | 816.10 |
| Occupied, occupancy date 59 whole months before | 0.5 of 10, that is 5 percent | 906.7741… multiplied by 0.95: 861.44 |
| In terminated status, or no agreement | None | 906.77 |
